title: TC-02 STAR ETERNAL
summary: In short, this model kit is a huge improvement from its predecessor Star Destroyer. The quality is better in many ways, with some problems still staying. If you are looking for a score, 8/10 would be my score, and that does not count the additional armor pieces it came with: two coloured armor parts and two different sets of effect in green and orange. You can mix them up as you like!
body: In short, this model kit is a huge improvement from its predecessor Star Destroyer. The quality is better in many ways, with some problems still staying. If you are looking for a score, 8/10 would be my score, and that does not count the additional armor pieces it came with: two coloured armor parts and two different sets of effect in green and orange. You can mix them up as you like!

The sore fingers you got from building Star Destroyer, you would still get them here in lesser degree. Where plastic meets alloy, it happens. But it is a mere convenience this time. Everything else goes well.
The parts fit into places and stay on the frame firmly. The joints are strong to hold themselves. And the base is quite something with its "mecha" design!
I'm not a big fan of Star Destroyer but I'm getting the hang of Iron Toys with Star Eternal so really looking forward to its third model kit: Star Fall!
Music: Shinsekai 「新世界」 from Bump of Chicken (played at 80% normal speed) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IQOhCvlkYps&ab_channel=BUMPOFCHICKEN
